title: D2. Доставка
description: Срок доставки, опоздания, оценки, маршруты и продавцы (mart.v_delivery, mart.v_delivery_item).

list.name: customer_state
list.label: Штат покупателя
list.description: Штат покупателя; All включает заказы без штата
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT customer_state FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT customer_state FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: seller_state
list.label: Штат продавца
list.description: Штат основного продавца заказа (для таблицы продавцов — штат продавца позиции); All включает записи без штата
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT seller_state_main FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE seller_state_main IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT seller_state_main FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE seller_state_main IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Категория
list.description: Основная категория заказа; All включает заказы без категории; на таблицу продавцов не действует
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category_main FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE category_main IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT category_main FROM mart.v_delivery WHERE category_main IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: В срок
panels.description: Доля доставленных заказов, пришедших не позже обещанной даты: COUNT(is_on_time) / COUNT(has_valid_dates) (metric_catalog.late_pct = 100 % минус это значение). Заказы с невалидными датами исключены. Срезы: период, штаты покупателя и продавца, категория.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_on_time)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates), 0) AS on_time_share
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Медиана срока
panels.description: Медианный срок доставки от покупки до вручения, дни (metric_catalog.median_delivery_days). Только заказы с валидными датами. Неаддитивная метрика, считается на срезе.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates))::numeric, 1) AS median_delivery_days
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: p90 срока
panels.description: 90-й перцентиль срока доставки, дни: percentile_cont(0.9) по delivery_days для заказов с валидными датами. 9 из 10 заказов доставлены не позже этого значения.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates))::numeric, 1) AS p90_delivery_days
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Опоздание (среднее)
panels.description: Среднее опоздание среди опоздавших заказов, дни: AVG(delay_days) для is_late. Заказы, пришедшие в срок, в расчёт не входят.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND((AVG(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE is_late))::numeric, 1) AS avg_delay_days
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Средняя оценка
panels.description: Средняя оценка отзыва по доставленным заказам, 1–5 (metric_catalog.avg_review_score): AVG(review_score_mean) по заказам с отзывом.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score_mean), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Оценки 1–2★
panels.description: Доля заказов с низкой оценкой: COUNT(review_score_mean <= 2) / COUNT(review_score_mean). Оценка заказа — средняя по его отзывам; заказы без отзыва в расчёт не входят.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score_mean <= 2)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(review_score_mean), 0) AS low_score_share
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Заказов
panels.description: Число доставленных заказов на текущем срезе (metric_catalog.orders_delivered): знаменатель для остальных показателей, включая заказы с невалидными датами.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Исключено из расчёта
panels.description: Доставленные заказы без валидных дат (has_valid_dates = FALSE): у них срок и опоздание не рассчитываются, в показатели доставки они не входят. Значения в источнике не правятся.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_valid_dates) AS excluded_orders
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))

panels.title: Доля в срок и срок доставки по месяцам
panels.description: По месяцу покупки: доля заказов в срок (левая ось), медиана и p90 срока доставки в днях (правая ось). Доли и перцентили неаддитивны: на каждом месяце считаются заново по заказам среза.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  purchase_month::timestamp AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_on_time)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates), 0) AS "Доля в срок",
  (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates))::numeric AS "Медиана срока, дн",
  (percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates))::numeric AS "p90 срока, дн"
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))
GROUP BY purchase_month
ORDER BY purchase_month

panels.title: Оценка по величине опоздания
panels.description: Средняя оценка заказов по корзинам опоздания: в срок, 1–3 дня, 4–7 дней, более 7 дней (late_bucket). Чем больше опоздание, тем ниже оценка. Заказы без валидных дат в корзины не попадают.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE late_bucket
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'В срок'
    WHEN '1-3' THEN '1–3 дня'
    WHEN '4-7' THEN '4–7 дней'
    ELSE 'Более 7 дней' END AS "Опоздание",
  ROUND(AVG(review_score_mean), 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))
  AND late_bucket IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY late_bucket
ORDER BY CASE late_bucket WHEN 'on_time' THEN 1 WHEN '1-3' THEN 2 WHEN '4-7' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Маршруты: средний срок доставки, дни
panels.description: Матрица маршрутов: строки — штат покупателя, столбцы — штат основного продавца заказа (по наибольшей Σ price), значение — средний срок доставки в днях. Показаны маршруты минимум с 30 заказами; пустая ячейка — маршрут не набрал 30 заказов на текущем срезе. Экспорт: Inspect → Data → CSV.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  customer_state AS "Штат покупателя",
  seller_state_main AS "Штат продавца",
  ROUND((AVG(delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates))::numeric, 1) AS "Средний срок, дн"
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))
  AND customer_state IS NOT NULL
  AND seller_state_main IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state, seller_state_main
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Заказы и оценка по корзинам опоздания
panels.description: По корзинам late_bucket: число заказов, число заказов с отзывом, доля корзины среди заказов с валидными датами (неаддитивно, пересчитывается на срезе) и средняя оценка. При полном периоде «Заказы с оценкой» = 89 443 / 1 852 / 1 748 / 2 781, как в mart.v_delivery_review.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE late_bucket
    WHEN 'on_time' THEN 'В срок'
    WHEN '1-3' THEN '1–3 дня'
    WHEN '4-7' THEN '4–7 дней'
    ELSE 'Более 7 дней' END AS "Опоздание",
  COUNT(*) AS "Заказы",
  COUNT(review_score_mean) AS "Заказы с оценкой",
  COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS "Доля заказов",
  ROUND(AVG(review_score_mean), 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM (SELECT * FROM mart.v_delivery OFFSET 0) AS v
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state_main IN ($seller_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($category) OR category_main IN ($category))
  AND late_bucket IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY late_bucket
ORDER BY CASE late_bucket WHEN 'on_time' THEN 1 WHEN '1-3' THEN 2 WHEN '4-7' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Продавцы: просрочка передачи перевозчику (без среза по категории)
panels.description: 20 продавцов с наибольшей долей позиций, переданных перевозчику позже shipping_limit (is_shipped_late), минимум 20 позиций. «Ср. задержка» — среднее опоздание только по просроченным позициям. Источник mart.v_delivery_item (без категории): учитываются период, штаты покупателя и продавца. Экспорт: Inspect → Data → CSV.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  seller_id AS "Продавец",
  seller_state AS "Штат",
  COUNT(*) AS "Позиции",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_shipped_late)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_shipped_late IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Передано позже срока",
  ROUND((AVG(ship_delay_days) FILTER (WHERE is_shipped_late))::numeric, 1) AS "Ср. задержка, дн",
  ROUND(AVG(review_score_mean), 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM mart.v_delivery_item
WHERE purchase_month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND purchase_month <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  AND ('*' IN ($customer_state) OR customer_state IN ($customer_state))
  AND ('*' IN ($seller_state) OR seller_state IN ($seller_state))
GROUP BY seller_id, seller_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST, 3 DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Определения
panels.description: Формулы метрик дословно из mart.metric_catalog.formula_sql; строки «(панель)» — показатели дашборда, которых нет в каталоге. Корзины опоздания: в срок — delay_days ≤ 0, 1–3 дня, 4–7 дней, более 7 дней. Заказ без валидных дат (has_valid_dates = FALSE) в показатели доставки не входит. Срез по продавцу и категории — по основному продавцу и основной категории заказа (наибольшая Σ price).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Метрика", formula_sql AS "Формула", source_view AS "Источник", unit AS "Единица",
  CASE WHEN is_additive THEN 'аддитивная' ELSE 'неаддитивная' END AS "Тип"
FROM mart.metric_catalog
WHERE metric_code IN ('late_pct', 'median_delivery_days', 'avg_delivery_days', 'avg_review_score', 'orders_delivered')
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  ('В срок (панель)', 'COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_on_time) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates), 0)', 'mart.v_delivery', 'share', 'неаддитивная'),
  ('p90 срока (панель)', 'percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE has_valid_dates)', 'mart.v_delivery', 'days', 'неаддитивная'),
  ('Опоздание среднее (панель)', 'AVG(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE is_late)', 'mart.v_delivery', 'days', 'неаддитивная'),
  ('Оценки 1–2★ (панель)', 'COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score_mean <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(review_score_mean), 0)', 'mart.v_delivery', 'share', 'неаддитивная'),
  ('Передано позже срока (панель)', 'COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_shipped_late) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_shipped_late IS NOT NULL), 0)', 'mart.v_delivery_item', 'share', 'неаддитивная')
) AS t("Метрика", "Формула", "Источник", "Единица", "Тип")
ORDER BY 3, 1
